claim: Implemented a one-block-per-row RMSNorm kernel using 256 threads, coalesced strided loads, warp-shuffle sum-of-squares reduction, and a small shared-memory warp-total array.
expected_effect: On Volta sm_70, warp shuffles keep the reduction register-local while the 32-float shared array minimizes synchronization and avoids shared-memory bank conflicts; one block per row provides parallelism across batch rows and coalesced accesses suit the 4096-wide shapes.
